name: 阳光算力工厂智算中心项目（兴宁）
developer: 深圳阳光数字技术有限公司 / 阳光新业
notes: Project selected in Xingning Yetang Industrial Park; reported as centered on a data center, with public reporting of CNY 980m investment, 242 high-power racks and 7.48 MW IT load; expected to move toward construction after filing/service coordination.

name: 广东省数字政府政务云梅州节点
developer: Meizhou municipal digital-government program / telecom IDC operators
notes: Local-government source says the Meizhou government-cloud node served 59 entities and 261 systems, with 1194 VMs, 12462 vCPU cores, 33 TB memory and 959 TB storage; Guangzhou-Meizhou cooperation plan references government-cloud and government big-data nodes supporting regional data-center business.

name: 腾讯清远清新云计算数据中心
developer: 清远市腾讯数码有限公司 / Tencent Cloud
notes: Tencent South China cloud base subproject in Qingxin/Taiping; reported as opened in July 2020, over 400 mu, 8 IT buildings, planned for about 300,000 servers; part of a 3-center Qingyuan campus planned for over 1 million servers.

name: 腾讯清远高新区云计算数据中心
developer: Tencent / 清远高新区
notes: Official Qingyuan development/reform project page places the project in Qingyuan High-tech Development Zone, with about 263,415 sq m land, 120,205 sq m floor area and CNY 10bn investment; press reports indicate 300,000-server planning.

name: 腾讯清远清城云计算数据中心
developer: 清远市腾讯网络技术有限公司 / Tencent
notes: Qingcheng water-conservation acceptance notice identifies the project and developer; Guangdong 2026 key-project list includes Tencent Qingyuan Qingcheng Cloud Computing Data Center as new-infrastructure/data-center work.

name: 中国移动（广东汕头）数据中心二期
developer: China Mobile Guangdong / 中国移动
notes: Reported filing approval for phase II in Haojiang District, Nanshanwan Industrial Park; total investment CNY 497m, IT power 45.4 MW, equivalent to 18,160 standard racks, planned construction from 2026-04-01 to 2028-12-01.

name: 中国移动粤东数据中心 / 中国移动（广东汕头）数据中心一期
developer: China Mobile Guangdong / 中国移动
notes: Same public filing coverage states the existing China Mobile Guangdong Shantou/Yuedong data center phase I entered service in April 2017 with 7,449 standard racks and 3.2T egress bandwidth.

name: 汕头政务云平台与广东省政务大数据中心汕头分节点
developer: 汕头市数字政府 / provincial digital-government program
notes: Public reporting says Shantou government-cloud platform was built and launched in August 2020, phase I passed acceptance on 2021-09-27, and the provincial government big-data-center Shantou node was deployed in November 2021.

name: 汕尾“明珠数谷”大数据产业园
developer: 汕尾市政府 / 汕尾工信部门
notes: Official/planning coverage describes a one-park/multi-site big-data industry park with Hongcao and Haifeng ecological-tech areas as start areas; targets 32,624 racks by 2022 and 72,035 racks by 2025, focused on data centers and data services.

name: 中瀚云大数据+智能制造产业园汕尾项目
developer: 深圳市中瀚云科技股份有限公司
notes: Shanwei High-tech Zone page says CNY 4bn planned investment; China Energy Engineering coverage says planning permit/design review passed, site in Shanwei High-tech Zone on 140 mu with 170,000 sq m high-grade data-center machine rooms.

name: 腾讯深汕/汕尾数据中心园区
developer: Tencent Cloud / Tencent Data Center
notes: Tencent Cloud developer article describes a Shanwei data-center park with 6 machine-room buildings, one enabled at the time, and total capacity of 150,000 servers; treated as operational but details remain limited in public sources.

name: 全国一体化算力网络粤港澳大湾区国家枢纽节点韶关数据中心集群
developer: 韶关市政府 / Guangdong national hub-node program
notes: National-hub Shaoguan cluster; reports say it has become a major South China AI/compute cluster, with 12-17万 standard-rack carrying capacity already built by 2026 reporting and larger signed/planned scale.

name: 中国移动粤港澳（韶关）数据中心
developer: China Mobile / 中国移动
notes: SASAC/China Daily report total investment CNY 5.6bn, planned 4 data centers, 2 power centers and an operations center; 32,000 standard racks planned, phase I 16,000 racks operational, phase II expected in 2026.

name: 粤港澳大湾区“国芯训国模”昇腾万卡智算集群
developer: China Telecom / Huawei / Shaoguan compute cluster partners
notes: Shaoguan government reposts Science and Technology Daily coverage of a Greater Bay Area Ascend 10,000-card intelligent-computing cluster going online; described as an autonomous domestic-model training compute base.

name: 腾讯粤港澳大湾区算力中心项目（韶关）
developer: Tencent
notes: Nanfang Metropolis Daily reports an investment-agreement signing for Tencent Greater Bay Area compute center in Shaoguan, planned investment around CNY 5bn and operable capacity around 200,000 servers.

name: 鹏城云脑Ⅱ
developer: 鹏城实验室
notes: PCL official page says Pengcheng Cloudbrain II has completed main construction and provides not less than 1000 Pops AI compute plus 64 PB high-speed storage; Shenzhen News describes it as a key open AI model-training platform.

name: 鹏城云脑Ⅲ / “鹏城云脑”网络智能重大科技基础设施
developer: 鹏城实验室 / 光明科学城
notes: Guangming District resource page lists the network-intelligence major science infrastructure; Shenzhen DRC reporting says Pengcheng Cloudbrain III is accelerating construction and will support 100B+ parameter model training.

name: 深圳前海信息枢纽大厦 / 前海数据中心
developer: 深圳市前海开发投资控股有限公司 / 前海管理局
notes: Qianhai authority reported the ultra-high-rise data-center/information-hub building completed in December 2023; CSCEC states about 68,800 sq m gross floor area and information-infrastructure rooms plus smart Qianhai operations center.

name: 深圳港集团智慧模块化数据中心
developer: Shenzhen Port Group / Huawei Digital Power
notes: Huawei case study states the phase has about 700 sq m data-center area and 90 planned IT racks at 6 kW per rack, using FusionModule2000; capacity calculated as 90*6 kW = 0.54 MW.

name: 阳江GW级海底算力中心
developer: 中国华电集团 / 中国联通 / 中科曙光 / 东莞中科云 / 中能建广东院 / 宁波大学 / 广东沧溟探源海洋科技等
notes: Reported as a GW-class subsea computing center in Yangjiang waters, planned total installed power 2,000 MW relying on offshore wind and staged implementation; highly ambitious and should be treated as announced/early-stage pending primary filings.

name: 云浮云计算大数据产业园数据中心
developer: 云浮市政府 / 华为 / 云浮市华云实业投资有限公司
notes: Huawei Cloud says Yunfu government and Huawei agreed in 2014 and broke ground on a cloud-computing big-data industrial park data center planned for 4 data buildings and about 80,000 sq m; Yunfu official tender notice covers phase-I construction inside the Yunfu New Area park.

name: 云浮云计算数据中心升级改造项目二期
developer: Yunfu cloud-computing data-center operators / Yunfu government
notes: Yun'an government 2026 planning text references speeding phase-II production of the Yunfu cloud-computing data-center upgrade/operation project; Guangdong 2026 key-project list names Yunfu Cloud Computing Data Center Upgrade Project Phase II.

name: 中国移动（广东湛江）数据中心 / 广东移动粤西数据中心
developer: China Mobile Guangdong / 中国移动
notes: C114 reports Guangdong Mobile West Guangdong/Zhanjiang data center as a five-star data center, with post-completion capacity of over 16,000 racks; later coverage notes China Mobile (Guangdong Zhanjiang) Data Center received national level-3 information-security certification.

name: 中国移动（广东湛江）数据中心二期工程
developer: China Mobile Guangdong / 中国移动
notes: Credit Guangdong administrative-license detail references energy-review handling for China Mobile (Guangdong Zhanjiang) Data Center Phase II, located in Xiashan District Huagang block, with total investment about CNY 1.189bn.

name: 湛江电信云计算中心
developer: China Telecom Zhanjiang / 中国电信
notes: Mazhang District government article states Zhanjiang Telecom Cloud Computing Center has entered operation; limited capacity details are public in this source.

name: 肇庆汇睿大数据中心
developer: 肇庆新区投资发展有限公司 / 汇睿大数据中心
notes: Located in Zhaoqing New Area Greater Bay Area Eco-Tech Industrial Park; reported as substantially built and trial-running by 2023-06-30, 27,000 sq m building, 3,248 racks at 6 kW each, with rental, storage and cloud services; capacity calculated from rack power.
